CctvInvalidSamplingChecker.doc: Error: sample grid/fraction drivers are invalid.

CctvMissingOpticsChecker.doc: Error: a sensor has no source optics evidence.

CctvUnsupportedTopologyChecker.doc: Error: a mesh has unsupported or malformed topology.

CctvKindMismatchChecker.doc: Warn: camera API classification must be IfcAudioVisualAppliance or a registered camera class.

CctvSensorMissingChecker.doc: Error: a camera element needs a Camera child wearing AecoCctvSensorAPI.

CctvSensorOrphanChecker.doc: Warn: sensor API on a Camera whose parent is not a camera element.

CctvOutOfEnvelopeChecker.doc: Error: pan, tilt or focal length (presets included) outside the sensor's ranges.

CctvNativeCameraAuthoredChecker.doc: Warn: stock camera attributes or xformOps authored on a sensor outside the derived layer.

CctvDerivedMismatchChecker.doc: Warn: derived hfov/vfov/effectiveWidth disagree with a recomputation from the drivers.

CctvMountFrameChecker.doc: Warn: downward mount tilted upward, or mount height outside a study's mountHeightRange.

CctvSystemCapacityChecker.doc: Warn: camera members of a system exceed its recorderCapacity.

CctvUnsupportedProjectionChecker.doc: Error: an included study sensor is not rectilinear.

CctvStudyIncompleteChecker.doc: Warn: result set is missing, duplicated or invalid.

CctvUnphasedProviderChecker.doc: Warn: an included camera or target has no authored phase.

CctvStudyMissingResultsChecker.doc: Info: the study has never been run.

CctvStudyStaleChecker.doc: Warn: the study's inputHash differs from the current inputs.

CctvTargetUncoveredChecker.doc: Error: no view covers the target at its requirement; names the blockers.

CctvTargetMostlyEnclosedChecker.doc: Warn: more than half the target samples are enclosed; redefine the region.

CctvPtzSoleCoverageChecker.doc: Warn: under presetsNotSole the requirement is met only by motorised presets (duty fraction in the message).

CctvTargetTooFarChecker.doc: Warn: no covering view within the study's maxTargetDistance.

CctvExclusionCoveredChecker.doc: Error: a view sees a sample point of an exclusion.

CctvUnphasedInViewChecker.doc: Warn: an element without an authored aeco:phase inside a view (counted as an obstacle).

CctvUnclassifiedInViewChecker.doc: Warn: a non-element gprim inside a view (counted as an obstacle).
